title: Natural gas seasonality and front-month Samuelson proxy
verdict_reasons: seasonality_pass=True: both NG=F and UNG permutation p<0.01 and peak/trough ratio>1.2
samuelson_proxy_pass=False: bdays coef=0.0036 t=1.28, near bucket coef=0.0217 t=0.58, bootstrap P(near>far)=0.199

methodology.seasonality: Monthly realized volatility from daily log returns; one-way ANOVA across calendar months plus 5,000-label permutation test.
methodology.monthly_regression: log monthly RV on winter and summer dummies with lagged log RV; HAC maxlags=3.
methodology.samuelson_proxy: NG=F continuous front-month proxy; expiry approximated as three business days before first day of delivery month, per CME rule. Daily log absolute return regressed on business days to expiry or near-expiry dummy, controlling for lagged log abs return, calendar-month FE, and year FE; HAC maxlags=5.
lookahead_controls: Monthly persistence control uses lag_log_rv_ann = t-1.
Daily persistence control uses lag_log_abs_ret = t-1.
No future returns are used to construct current month or daily predictors.
Samuelson expiry proxy uses exchange calendar rule, not realized future volatility.
limitations: NG=F is a Yahoo continuous front-month proxy, not a contract-level panel.
Yahoo roll timing may differ from the CME active-contract convention.
Expiry and business-day counts use a standard weekday calendar, not a full CME holiday calendar.
Weekend-labelled futures rows are dropped to keep business-day expiry counts coherent.
No options-implied vol or full term-structure curve is used.

literature_sources.source: Samuelson (1965), Proof that properly anticipated prices fluctuate randomly
Mu (2007), Weather, Storage, and Natural Gas Price Dynamics
literature_sources.role: Documents natural gas volatility effects from weather, storage, and contract horizon.

literature_sources.source: CME Rulebook Chapter 220, Henry Hub Natural Gas Futures
literature_sources.role: Defines NG last trading day as three business days before delivery month.

literature_sources.source: CME Introduction to Natural Gas Seasonality
literature_sources.role: Describes storage/consumption seasonality and heating/cooling demand mechanism.

related_k.K1461: UNG month-of-year RV seasonality already found strong February-vs-September pattern; K1504 differentiates by adding NG=F and expiry-distance proxy.
related_k.inventory_seasonality_surprise_regime_co: Low-inventory seasonal interaction was NULL for NG=F/UNG; K1504 does not use inventory regimes.
related_k.K1339: Commodity ETF momentum-regime switch event study; K1504 avoids calling ETF momentum a true futures-curve regime.

NG=F.model: log_rv_ann ~ is_winter + other season dummy + lag_log_rv_ann
log_rv_ann ~ is_summer + other season dummy + lag_log_rv_ann

UNG.model: log_rv_ann ~ is_winter + other season dummy + lag_log_rv_ann
log_rv_ann ~ is_summer + other season dummy + lag_log_rv_ann

samuelson_regressions.model: daily log_abs_ret ~ bdays_to_expiry + lag_log_abs_ret + month FE + year FE
daily log_abs_ret ~ near_expiry_5bd + lag_log_abs_ret + month FE + year FE
